failedChecks.detail: The DigitalBridge period rendered as an estimated attribution rather than disclosed DigitalBridge Fund III ownership, and the disclosed Crestview III investment-funds period rendered as fund attribution pending.
The directly disclosed EnCap Energy Transition Fund III ownership period rendered as fund attribution pending.
The ECP ownership period rendered the unsupported ECP Fund V estimate instead of the disclosed ECP Energy Transition Opportunities Fund.
The ECP ownership period rendered the unsupported ECP Fund V estimate, and the direct Avolta, LLC joint-venture interest rendered as fund attribution pending.

rootCause: The atomic PortCo after-images correctly changed company and ownership-period identity fields but intentionally do not overwrite the independent OwnershipPeriod fund-attribution metadata. Newly added periods retained the default UNRESOLVED state, while existing ECP periods preserved older INFERRED ECP Fund V metadata even though the reviewed seed attribution manifest contains the correct current classifications.
containment: The batch ledger moved from VERIFYING to VERIFYING_FAILED. No subsequent release bundle may start until a protected attribution-only correction updates the six affected current ownership periods and renewed API and rendered-card verification passes.
